project_context.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) modified for Dark Mode
project_context.core_aesthetic: Sleek, cinematic media dashboard. Deep dark background minimizes distraction so the primary Cyan (#48C7F2) accents and video player can dominate the visual hierarchy. Precision-driven, zero-muddy gradients.

headings.description: Punchy, modern grotesque for dashboard metrics and landing page headers. Never use Inter or Roboto for headers.

body.description: Sterile, highly readable sans for dense dashboard data, tables, and tabs.

monospace.description: Used for embed codes, technical IDs, and IPs.

background.description: Obsidian black. Never pure #000000; slight blue tint.

dashboard.grid: Control Room Grid (Dense). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
dashboard.padding: p-6 to p-8 for internal cards
dashboard.radius: rounded-lg (Max 8px for a sharp, tech-forward look. No overly bubbly corners).

public_player.tabs: Browser-style tabs. Tightly packed, sharp corners at the top, bordering directly onto the video player frame to mimic an active browser window.

player_tabs.style: Neumorphic/Tactile hybrid but hard-edged. Active tab gets background #1C1C21 with a top 2px solid border in Primary Cyan (#48C7F2). Inactive tabs are darker (#0A0A0C) with lowered text opacity. Must include 16x16px favicons.
player_tabs.favicon_api: Use https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain={domain}&sz=64 for dynamic favicons based on hosters (e.g., doodstream.com, voe.sx).

buttons.primary: bg-[#48C7F2] text-[#050505] font-semibold rounded hover:bg-[#6BD3F4] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#48C7F2] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#050505]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#17171C] text-white border border-[#222228] hover:border-[#48C7F2] transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-transparent text-[#EF4444] border border-[#EF4444] hover:bg-[#EF4444] hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.default: bg-[#0F0F12] border border-[#222228] rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm

forms.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#222228] rounded focus:border-[#48C7F2] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#48C7F2] text-white placeholder-zinc-600 px-4 py-2

charts.styling: Dark mode tailored. Tooltips must have bg-[#0F0F12] and border-[#222228]. Line/Bar color should use #48C7F2.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text/bg color on hover (e.g. hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
interactions_and_motion.tab_switch: Instant snap for video tab switching to feel responsive and native.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based. Examples: 'login-submit-button', 'host-tab-doodstream', 'embed-link-input', 'copy-clipboard-button'.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Use 'duotone' or 'regular' weight for dashboard tools.

images.description: Dark teal wavy shapes on black. Used for the authentication page right-side panel to contrast with the dark sleek form.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use React Router for navigation. Setup User Dashboard, Admin Dashboard, and a Public Player Route.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a reusable 'BrowserTabs' component for the public player that takes a list of hosts, fetches their favicons via the Google Favicon API, and sets the highest paying host as default.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the Admin dashboard, include a section to manage 'Per-Country Earning Rates' (mock data with table).
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The embed link creation form must accept multiple text inputs (one per supported host) and generate a single ListMirror-style embed URL.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not use .tsx files. Use .js and .jsx extensions.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use Recharts for the statistics page showing views over time.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use generic gray gradients. Keep backgrounds solid Obsidian/Card colors with precise 1px borders.
